newsitem.title: USA: Tarrant Apparel reaffirms higher Q4 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Tarrant Apparel reaffirms higher Q4 EPS.

text.p: Tarrant Apparel Group on Tuesday reiterated that it expects fourth quarter sales to improve at least 25 percent and fourth quarter earnings to improve at least 50 percent from the year-ago figures.
"We remain extremely comfortable with the tone of our business and look forward to a strong fourth quarter," the company stated.
The company reaffirmed its fourth quarter estimates after releasing third quarter earnings of $0.34 per share, compared to the year-ago figure of $0.18 per share.
